systems.country_label: Système intégré de gestion des ressources humaines

MLI.note: SIGRH is still being rolled out in phases (identification of agents, then data integration); no payroll system is stated to be in use.
RAVEC biometrics are used to update staff files, but the document does not describe a national ID system issuing unique identities.

facts.fact: Mali's SIGRH human resources software was designed and developed by computer specialists of the Malian administration and financed entirely from the national budget, with its database to be hosted in Mali; no contractor is named.
